gc=g
def search(forced,k):
    F=np.c_[tuple(forced)] if forced else np.zeros((len(P),0))
    idx=np.array(list(combinations(range(n),k)))
    A=np.c_[F,M];Gm=A.T@A;bv=A.T@gc;nf=F.shape[1]
    cols=np.c_[np.tile(np.arange(nf),(len(idx),1)),idx+nf]
    GG=Gm[cols[:,:,None],cols[:,None,:]]+1e-13*np.eye(nf+k)
    bb=bv[cols]
    try: x=np.linalg.solve(GG,bb[:,:,None])[:,:,0]
    except Exception as e: print(e);return
    sse=gc@gc-(x*bb).sum(1)
    o=np.argsort(sse)[:8]
    for j in o:print('%.2e'%(sse[j]/len(P)/np.var(g)),[names[q] for q in idx[j]])
